* Stat Boon (lv X): Increases party ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND by X% of the respective Historia Crystal's total stats, after modifiers
* Ancient Echo: Attack (lv X): Increases party damage dealt by X% for matching realm members
* Ancient Echo: Protection (lv X): Reduces party damage taken by X% for matching realm members
* Ancient Echo: Blessing (lv X): Increases party damage dealt by X% and reduces party damage taken by X% for matching realm members
* Healing & Health Boon (lv X): Increases all HP restored to all allies by X% & Increases party max HP by X% of the Historia Crystal's total max HP
* Critical Boost (lv X): Increases party critical chance and critical damage by X% (additive with other critical chance and damage modifiers)
* Anti-Damage (lv X): Reduces party physical and magical damage taken from PHY, NAT, BLK, WHT, BLU or SUM attacks by X%
* Fast Act (lv X): Increases party cast speed by X%
* Surging Power (lv X): Increases party damage dealt by X*HP/10000 percent, where HP is the character's current amount of HP (max +X%, reached at 10000 HP)
* Antiquity Gambit (lv x): Increase party damage by x% against matching realm D700 Crystal Dungeon
